text:
I could only partly test these pages. The tool hit its time limit on several of them, and one page it refused to run. Anything it didn't finish is NEEDS_REVIEW, and I did not guess at those.

**Tool limits**
- **`/missions/`:** the tool refused to run it because it has 98 form fields. Every criterion is NEEDS_REVIEW. Rerunning with `no_time_limit=true` would test it.
- **`/gallery/ksc-history/`:** its run had not finished when I wrote this, so every criterion is NEEDS_REVIEW.
- **`/feature/naca-at-110-special-feature/` and `/mission/artemis-iii/`:** the time limit cut off most tests. Only the results the tool actually returned are reported.

**Site-wide findings**
- **2.4.1 Bypass Blocks:** FAIL on 6 of 9 pages (all but the three untested above). Each page starts with the same header block ("Explore", search, "News & Events", "Multimedia"). No skip link works from the top of the page.
- **2.4.7 Focus Visible:** FAIL on `/spot-the-station/`, `/careers/`, `/mission/artemis-iii/` and the news release. Each has links or buttons that show no focus change. The tool could not get a clear view of a few others, so those need a person to look.
- **3.2.3 Consistent Navigation:** PASS on all six pages where it finished (the three untested pages above excluded).
- **Header search field:** it has only placeholder text and a visible "Explore" button. I could not confirm a visible label for the 3.3.2 and 2.4.6 criteria, so those stay NEEDS_REVIEW.
- **2.4.3 Focus Order and 2.4.5 Multiple Ways:** these are NEEDS_REVIEW everywhere. The tool found focus jumping back up the page in the footer and the video player. It also found only one way (site search) to reach each page, and its other candidate way (the sitemap) was not checked.

**Page-specific findings**
- **`/spot-the-station/`, 3.2.2 On Input:** FAIL. The "City:" select sends the user to another address when changed, and nothing before it says so. The tool left this question open. I called it from the evidence, so it deserves a person's confirmation.
- **`/spot-the-station/`, 2.1.1 Keyboard:** NEEDS_REVIEW because of an embedded frame the tool could not read and an open question about the "Country:" select.
- **`/?search=artemis`, 2.1.1 Keyboard:** NEEDS_REVIEW because the "Last Month (543)" filter input is not reached by keyboard. The tool left that question open.
- **`/forms/nssc-accounts-receivable`:** 2.1.2, 2.4.7, 3.2.1 and 3.2.4 pass. The labels on the form fields could not be confirmed. The tool could not see what the server returns on a bad submit, so the error criteria need a live check.
- **`/careers/`:** the tool's first finished pass found no problems in 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 3.2.1 or 3.2.2.
- **The news release:** the same four criteria pass, and so does 1.3.1/4.1.2 for the fields it checked.
